goal.title: Signals and Systems
goal.capstone: Design and analyze a simple digital low-pass filter

answers.question: What do you want to be able to do when you finish this course?
answers.answer: Pass the final exam and be able to design a simple digital filter on my own.

answers.question: Should the map cover continuous-time and discrete-time signals equally?
answers.answer: Both, with more weight on discrete-time.

answers.question: How comfortable are you with calculus and complex numbers?
answers.answer: Calculus is fine; complex numbers I've only seen briefly.
